newsitem.title: USA: Hungarian Telephone increases access lines.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian Telephone increases access lines.

text.p: Hungarian Telephone and Cable Corp said Tuesday it had increased by 12 percent since February the number of access lines in Hungary.
A company spokesman said it had reported in February that it had 100,000 access lines in place. As of April 1, the company had 112,000 telephone access lines in place.
The company said it is projecting 175,000 access lines in place by year end, which is an increase of 15,000 lines from its projection in the beginning of the year.
Hungarian Telephone and Cable Corp provides telephone services in five regions of the Republic of Hungary.
